name: outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.FullState.mk.noConfusion
type_text:
{d m n : ℕ} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {original : List (Fin m)} →
      {remaining : List ℕ} →
        {point sum : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d} →
          {pending : Fin n → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m)} →
            {clock : NNReal} →
              {rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow} →
                {nextID : ℕ} →
                  {original' : List (Fin m)} →
                    {remaining' : List ℕ} →
                      {point' sum' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d} →
                        {pending' : Fin n → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m)} →
                          {clock' : NNReal} →
                            {rows' : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow} →
                              {nextID' : ℕ} →
                                { original := original, remaining := remaining, point := point, sum := sum,
                                      pending := pending, clock := clock, rows := rows, nextID := nextID } =
                                    { original := original', remaining := remaining', point := point', sum := sum',
                                      pending := pending', clock := clock', rows := rows', nextID := nextID' } →
                                  (original ≍ original' →
                                      remaining = remaining' →
                                        point ≍ point' →
                                          sum ≍ sum' →
                                            pending ≍ pending' → clock = clock' → rows = rows' → nextID = nextID' → P) →
                                    P
